title: Recent advances in functional materials for uranium monitoring through optical and electrochemical techniques
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,21487-21509
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02232D, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
KaiZeng Quan, YuMin Wang, Meng Qi, Peng Xu, YaXing Wang, GuoXun Ji
This review summarizes progress in UO22+ optical and electrochemical detection using MOFs, COFs, nanomaterials and DNAzymes, compares different materials and methods, and discusses challenges and future directions for UO22+ detection.
